    name: "remote-loader",
    summary: "<p>remote-loader 是一个面向 React 的远程模块加载工具，基于 Webpack 5 Module Federation 设计，适合将不同团队、不同发布节奏的功能模块在运行时进行组合。</p>\n<h4>特点</h4>\n<ul>\n<li>支持 <code>RemoteLoader</code>、<code>withRemoteLoader</code>、<code>useLoader</code> 三种接入方式，覆盖声明式、HOC 与 Hook 场景。</li>\n<li>支持完整的 token 语法：可按远程名、版本、子模块、属性路径精确定位到目标导出。</li>\n<li>内置模块缓存与复用机制，避免重复加载，提高首屏后交互性能。</li>\n<li>支持全局与局部兜底（<code>fallback</code> / <code>error</code>）能力，远程模块异常时可平滑降级。</li>\n<li><code>preset</code> 支持深度合并配置，便于在不同环境下渐进覆盖远程地址与模板参数。</li>\n<li>新增 <code>getGlobal</code> 用于读取当前全局配置快照，便于调试与配置诊断。</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>适用场景</h4>\n<ul>\n<li>微前端主应用按需加载业务子模块。</li>\n<li>组件平台动态装配跨仓库组件。</li>\n<li>需要按版本灰度远程模块并快速回滚的前端系统。</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>使用体验亮点</h4>\n<ul>\n<li>API 简洁，单个 <code>module</code> 字符串即可完成远程组件挂载。</li>\n<li>在复杂场景下可直接使用 <code>useLoader</code> 获取加载状态与模块对象，易于与现有状态管理整合。</li>\n<li>提供 <code>getPublicPath</code>、<code>getStaticPath</code> 等路径辅助函数，减少远程地址拼装错误。</li>\n</ul>",
    description: "加载一个webpack5生成的邦联模块",

    title: "RemoteLoader 属性子模块链式渲染",
    description: "按 InfoPage -> InfoPage.Part -> Descriptions 的链路加载属性子模块，并传入含 JSX 的 dataSource 结构。",
    code: "const {default: Remote} = remoteLoader;\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n    return <Remote module=\"InfoPage\">\n        <Remote module=\"InfoPage.Part\" title=\"退票信息\">\n            <Remote module=\"Descriptions\"\n                    dataSource={[[{label: \"客户名称\", content: \"腾讯\"}, {\n                        label: \"发票抬头\", content: \"腾讯科技公司\"\n                    }], [{label: \"发票类型\", content: \"增值税专用发票\"}, {\n                        label: \"发票开具日期\", content: \"2022-08-15\"\n                    }], [{label: \"退票金额\", content: \"22000.00元\"}], [{\n                        label: \"发票号\", content: <div>\n                            <div>00384895992774</div>\n                            <div>00384895992774</div>\n                            <div>00384895992774</div>\n                            <div>00384895992774</div>\n                        </div>\n                    }], [{label: \"是否需要重开发票\", content: \"否\"}, {\n                        label: \"是否涉及金融变动\", content: \"否\"\n                    }], [{label: \"是否造成实质损失\", content: \"否\"}, {\n                        label: \"责任归属\", content: \"客户原因\"\n                    }], [{label: \"退票原因\", content: \"退票原因的描述退票原因的描述退票原因的描\"}], [{\n                        label: \"附件\", content: \"附件名称\"\n                    }], [{label: \"操作时间\", content: \"2022-08-01 16:32\"}, {label: \"操作人\", content: \"西西歪\"}]]}/>\n        </Remote>\n    </Remote>;\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample/>);\n\n",

},{
    title: "JSX Props 稳定性与异常重建排查",
    description: "module 固定为字符串，通过动态/稳定两组 JSX props 对照，观察远程组件在重渲染过程中的挂载与卸载行为。",
    code: "const {createWithRemoteLoader} = remoteLoader;\nconst {useEffect, useMemo, useState} = React;\n\nconst LogNode = ({label}) => {\n    useEffect(() => {\n        console.log(`[mount]`);\n        return () => {\n            console.log('[unmount]');\n        };\n    }, []);\n\n    return <span>{label}</span>;\n};\n\nconst RemoteContent = createWithRemoteLoader({\n    modules: [\"components-core:Content\"]\n})(({remoteModules, titleSlot, list}) => {\n    const [Content] = remoteModules;\n    return <Content title={titleSlot} list={list}/>;\n});\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n    const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        const timer = setInterval(() => {\n            setTick((current) => current + 1);\n        }, 1200);\n\n        return () => {\n            clearInterval(timer);\n        };\n    }, []);\n\n    const stableTitleSlot = useMemo(() => {\n        return <LogNode label=\"stable-title-slot\"/>;\n    }, []);\n\n    const unstableTitleSlot = <LogNode label={`unstable-title-slot-${tick}`}/>;\n\n    return <div>\n        <RemoteContent\n            titleSlot={unstableTitleSlot}\n            list={[\n                {\n                    label: \"动态 JSX（可能触发异常重建）\",\n                    content: <LogNode label={`unstable-content-${tick}`}/>\n                }\n            ]}\n        />\n\n        <RemoteContent\n            titleSlot={stableTitleSlot}\n            list={[\n                {\n                    label: \"稳定 JSX（用于对照）\",\n                    content: <LogNode label=\"stable-content\"/>\n                }\n            ]}\n        />\n    </div>;\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample/>);\n\n",
    scope: [{
    name: "remoteLoader",
    packageName: "@kne/remote-loader",
    component: component_1
}]
}]
